body.message:
Dear Michelle,

Thank you for your message and for sharing your requirements with us.

We would like to inform you that our bookings for January 2027 onward are not yet open, so we are currently unable to confirm availability or provide the long-stay rates for your requested dates.

We kindly request you to get back in touch with us in November, when we expect to have the availability and rates updated. At that time, we will be happy to assist you with the available 1-bedroom options and provide you with the full details, including the rates, inclusions, deposit, payment terms, and cancellation policy.

Thank you for your kind understanding, and we look forward to assisting you further.
